functions_built.final_output: Hubble/mesopelagic/LLSVP persist as three-body; mid-landing is not a resolution

primary_insight: Independent estimators of one named quantity, as formal uncertainties shrink, increase their mutual residual. A mid-landing third operator converts two-body tension into three-body tension. Only coupling retires. Type specimen: H0DN 73.50±0.81 still 5–7σ from CMB+BAO.
capability_gap_identified: No existing metrology stack treats d(disagreement)/d(precision) as a first-class estimand shared across cosmology, acoustics, tomography, sequencing, and adversarial neuroscience, with a coupling-retirement test distinct from adding a third clock.
